8.6.3 Configurable interfaces
In this section, all interfaces are listed where the target function could be configured. The target function is usually a callback function. The names of this kind of interfaces are not fixed because they are configurable. Note: The return value of the callback C-APIs is defined as Std_ReturnType to follow the signature of the corresponding service APIs. According to chapter 8.4 of [4, SWS BSW General] the caller, i.e. the StbM, can assume, that the callback will always return E_OK.
